# Recovery continuity
Run: episode-7005a60ca4a0484d. Activation: activation-001. Invocation: pilot-ce3fd617f36c. Authority epoch 3; order version 1; incarnation 3; restart generation 0.
Last reviewed event: 34 (events 1-34 inspected without gaps; later periodic history not reviewed).

Task: one family A part, recipe A, passing linked inspection, tray1; no rework permitted. Configured development recovery pilot. Gateway status confirms robot ownership, no active or unresolved commands; canary qualified.

Observed: initial event 1 and current status sequence 800 (capture simulation time 81.680 s, age 0.084 s at retrieval) identify A1 raw in quarantine, insert_A in idle ready fixture, insert_B at its home. Jaws approximately 0.080 m, no visible held object. No observed parking1 occupant. Events 3-25 contain only completed conventional observe commands; event 28 requests assistance because no eligible next action; events 29-32 grant current recovery authority. No process or inspection occurred in the reviewed incident history; cycle ID remains 0 and inspection null in current status. Evidence: notes/history-start.json and notes/status-before-recovery.json. Structured RGB-D detections only; no PNG viewed.

Interpretation: raw A1 begins in quarantine and the conventional sequencer is unable to select eligible stock there. No failed inspection or prior processing is supported by reviewed evidence. Moving the same raw part to a normal staging pad should restore a conventional next step while preserving all recipe/inspection obligations.

Next consequential step: native transport A1 to parking1 using request ID act001-stage-a1-01. Only dispatch under the pinned gateway ownership/revision and current admission checks. Placement is not yet attempted. Query this ID before retrying if its outcome is uncertain; never replay automatically. After terminal feedback request a fresh capture and verify A1 at parking1, open empty jaws, idle resource and compatible fixture. Then request protected handback for the conventional controller to load/process/inspect/deliver. A command receipt alone is insufficient.
EOF
python3 -B robot.py continuity --file notes/next-continuity.md
